## 📂 Files & Logs

- `FUSE.log` (usually at `C:\Users\<username>\AppData\LocalLow\Giraffe Lab LLC\Railroader\FUSE.log`)
- `Player.log` (path similar to above)
- Affected package folder or zip
- `conversion-report.json` and `conversion-report.md`
- Screenshots (map, scenery, company window, progression issues)
- Output or screenshots of relevant commands:
  - `/fuse.report`
  - `/fuse.loaded`
  - `/fuse.conflicts`
  - `/fuse.graph` (for graph or track issues)
  - `/fuse.operations` (industries, stations, loaders, turntables)
  - `/fuse.progressions` (map or progression visibility issues)
  - `/fuse.assets` (missing scenery assets)
